$description: Single source of design tokens for CAPIE (Cyprian's API Extender) and the mods built on it, starting with Rename Anything. One palette, one type, motion and icon system for both; the products differ only in name and mark (see 'product'). Hex values marked 'sampled' were measured read-only from the installed HOI4 1.19.3.0 textures; 'game' values are copied from the textcolors table in interface/core.gfx; 'web' values are adjusted for WCAG contrast. Paths in 'from' are relative to a HOI4 installation. Format: W3C Design Tokens draft ($value/$type).

sources.samples: median and highlight pixels of gfx/interface textures listed per token

changes.1.3.0: CAPIE mark is now Overprint (the capie-mods organisation mark: a perforated parchment stamp, olive field, khaki old name struck by two vermilion bars, brass new name above, tilted -7 degrees). Adds the brand-only colour 'vermilion' for its strike bars.
changes.1.2.0: Anti-slop audit (docs/design/audit-anti-slop.md): no chips inside nodes, no ambient pulses or glow flashes, neutral badge rims, marks reserved for product icons, label-caps only for real group names, explicit anti-pattern list in 'avoid'.

window-ink.use: Deepest backdrop. Outer frame of web panels.

field-ink.use: Recessed areas: text fields and diagram nodes.

panel-umber.use: Panel and editor background. Diagram canvas.

panel-rim.use: Hairline borders, badge rims and the dividers that separate columns inside one node.

steel-bevel.use: Icon frame highlight, neutral node strokes, connector lines.

olive-button.use: Button fill; value part of a 'supported' badge.

pencil-green.use: Edit affordance: the notepad of the pencil icon.

pencil-green-lit.use: Pencil highlight; the 'works today' status mark.

brass.use: The native layer: library outline in diagrams, 'planned' tag text, the CAPIE value in the endorsement badge. Never a decorative rim.

brass-dim.use: Dashed outline of planned items (nodes, badges, legend). Strokes only, never small text.

vermilion.from: overprint ink of the capie-mods organisation mark (capie-mods/.github tools/make_assets.py)
vermilion.use: The two strike bars of the Overprint mark and the strike rules of Workshop section headers only. Brand colour, never a state, never text.

parchment.use: Primary text on web. In game use the default white.

khaki.use: Secondary text, hints, neutral status line.

header-amber.use: Group labels that name a real layer or column, the in-progress status and at most one highlighted value per view. Never a slogan, an eyebrow above a heading, or body text.

go-green.use: Works today, success. In game use §G.

alarm-red.use: Errors and blocking conditions. On web place on field-ink only (5.0:1).

caution-orange.use: API not loaded, fallback paths, unknown game version.

warning-rust.use: Warning glyph fill and fallback strokes.

field.use: Text typed into a native edit box.

title.use: Names shown next to a pencil, editor titles.

status.use: One-line status and error text under fields.

sans.use: All web UI text. Ubuntu is the face behind the game's hoi_* fonts and ships under the free Ubuntu Font Licence; load it only where external fonts are allowed (release pages). SVGs on GitHub fall back to installed fonts.

serif.$value: 'EB Garamond', Garamond, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
serif.use: Tooltip-like asides and quotations, echoing the game's Garamond tooltips.

label-caps.use: Diagram group labels in header-amber that name a real layer or column (for example 'HEARTS OF IRON IV 1.19.3.0'). Never a slogan or an eyebrow repeating the heading below it. Evokes the game's Orator headers without using them.

pencil-gap.note: Minimum gap between name text and pencil

ease-settle.use: Things arriving and stopping: a moving token, the cursor. Never bounce or elastic.

ease-linear.use: Timeline keyframes that only switch visibility.

loop-short.use: Reserved. Ambient data pulses were removed in 1.2.0 as decoration; a structure diagram stays still.

loop-story.use: A full user story (edit in place). The one animated diagram that shows what the player does.

loop-chain.use: Two-branch flows (launch chain): one token per branch, no colour flashes.

rest-min.use: At least 20 % of every loop is still.

pulse-radius.use: Radius of a moving token in a flow diagram.

avoid.$description: Patterns this system rejects everywhere: README, diagrams, sites, launcher, CLI and in game. Each entry is a rule, not a preference. Rationale in DESIGN-SYSTEM.md, 'Don't'.
web: side-tab accent borders (a coloured border-left or border-right thicker than 1 px on cards, callouts or list items)
gradient text and gradient fills
glassmorphism, backdrop blur as decoration
glow, neon on dark, zero-offset coloured halos, colour-flash animations
cyan, purple or blue-violet palettes
cards or chips inside a card or node; use columns and hairline dividers
grids of identical icon + heading + text cards
hero metric: big number, small label, supporting stats
generic rounded rectangles with drop shadows; radius above 2 px on nodes, any drop shadow
bounce or elastic easing
pure black #000 or pure white #fff on the web
decorative sparklines, progress rings or charts without data
an icon or mark above or before every heading; marks only where a product icon is needed
monospace as a costume for 'technical'; mono only for code, hashes and CLI output
centring everything; text is left-aligned
one uniform spacing value everywhere; use the 4/8/14/24/32 steps by relationship
eyebrow or kicker slogans above headings
ambient infinite motion that carries no information
emoji or Unicode glyphs as icons
a different accent colour per badge or per box
game: custom sprites, frames or ornaments where a vanilla sprite exists
§ colour codes for emphasis; §Y/§H at most once per view, §R/§O/§G only for state
exclamation marks, 'Successfully', success toasts or pop-ups
product name or logo inside an editor or next to a pencil
several identical icons in a row distinguished only by tooltip
fonts without Polish glyphs for player-entered text
